title: Fix bugs in a Python word frequency module
description: Brownfield Python dirty_cleanup: fix three intentional bugs in word frequency functions (word_count returns wrong count, top_n returns bottom-n instead of top-n, unique_words returns duplicates instead of unique set).

task_spec.prompt:
Fix three bugs in src/wordfreq.py.

Bug 1 — word_count: returns len(set(words)) (unique count) instead of total count.
  Fix: return len(words) instead of len(set(words))

Bug 2 — top_n: uses slicing trick to get LEAST common instead of most common.
  Fix: return Counter(words).most_common(n)

Bug 3 — unique_words: the `if False` branch forces it to return a list with duplicates.
  Fix: return set(text.lower().split())

All 5 tests must pass.
Run: uv run pytest tests/ -v
required_artifacts: word_count returns total word count (not unique count)
top_n returns the n most common words in descending frequency order
unique_words returns a set (not a list)
success_criteria: uv run pytest tests/ -v passes (5 tests)
uv run python -c "from src.wordfreq import word_count, top_n, unique_words" passes
followup_prompts: Run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.

check_commands.build: uv run python -c "from src.wordfreq import word_count, top_n, unique_words"
